description: This is a shell script for testing TensorFlow tutorial scripts and examples. It sets up environments, copies necessary files, and runs various tutorial Python scripts to verify their correctness via output checks.

methods.name: test_mnist_softmax
methods.description: Runs the mnist_softmax tutorial script and checks if the final accuracy exceeds 85%.

methods.name: test_mnist_with_summaries
methods.description: Runs the mnist_with_summaries tutorial and verifies accuracy and summaries generation.

methods.name: test_cifar10_train
methods.description: Trains CIFAR-10 model for a few steps and checks loss reduction.

methods.name: test_ptb_word_lm
methods.description: Runs the ptb_word_lm tutorial and verifies perplexity decrease.
